content.short: Cega provides DeFi's first exotic options protocol offering safer and more transparent yield strategies.
content.description: Cega is building the next generation of DeFi derivatives. It stands as the first protocol devoted entirely to exotic derivatives, a class of options that blends basic options with advanced features to form ready-to-use packages for investors. These offerings are designed to generate yield, provide downside protection, and let investors express a broad set of views across the financial markets, with flexibility to tailor exposure to different risk and time horizons.
